text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Okay, everyone! It's time to start the
prize
drawing! I hope you're ready for
this chance of a
lifetime!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The lottery results will be streamed here
live.
Thank you for... all your entries...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The "Win Big! ☆ Umazing Prizes
Handpicked by
Top Umamusume! ♪"
event is finally starting!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hiiii! Falco here,
starting things off with
a bang!
My personally picked, very
special present is...
choice_data_list: (Let's do our best to help with th...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
This pouch filled with awesome Falco 
merchandise! ☆ It's got portrait photos,
figure
stands, stickers... all signed by
yours truly!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You can even use the pouch for
everyday items!
Hehe! ☆ Now, here goes
the drawing!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Spin, spin, spin! There it is! And the
winner is...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Pyoiko, entry number 6048!
Congratulations! I
hope this brings you
lots of joy!

text_block_list.name: Viewer Comments
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa! So jealous! Congrats!" "Wish it
were me! At least there's a participation 
prize（^^）/" "Look at that design!
Falco, your fashion sense
rocks"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Haha! ☆ It does? I'm glad you think so!
It might
look like a simple pouch, but
the material's
quality stuff.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wow! The comments are flooding in! ☆
Falco's
great at generating good qi!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
She really is. I wonder whose is next...
Bourbon's?
Her present is a little...
unusual.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! But it's got nice feng shui. ♪ I can
feel the
positive qi from here! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I thank you all for the numerous entries
to the
drawing. The item I selected is...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My music box received more entries than
I
estimated... Experiencing "amazement."

text_block_list.name: Viewer Comments
text_block_list.text:
"Pick me, pick me, pick me!" "I'm a
longtime fan, but I've never seen a prize 
like this!" "Do you like this kind of
soothing sound,
Bourbon?"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I like this music box's tone. But
there is
another reason I chose it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The music player is malfunctioning
again... Failure
to verify the effects of
music on muscle training.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... There must be some analog way
for you to
listen to music... I know! What
do you think of
this?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: This music box is exceptional...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Sensing... moderate relaxation of all
muscles.
Concentration and motivation
levels rising.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The tone is difficult to define. It is a
metallic
sound, and yet... soft.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
After that, my father helped me obtain
music
boxes of various songs.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The music box I chose for this present is
the same
as the favorite one I had. It is
"my pick."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I projected that this item would bring
"me" to the
mind of its winner.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
That is the hope behind my selection.
Though... I
cannot certify that it will
result in happiness.

text_block_list.name: Viewer Comments
text_block_list.text:
"ngl thats lit fr"
"I love this! I want it! I
NEED IT! NEEEED!" "You put so much
thought into it... I'm gonna
cryyyy!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I am very glad.

text_block_list.name: Viewer Comments
text_block_list.text:
"!!!!!"
"Bourbooooon!"
"Digital's losing it
rn!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Talk complete. My allotted time is
finished.
Proceeding to next task:
drawing.

text_block_list.name: Viewer Comments
text_block_list.text:
"Waaaait, I need to mentally prepare!" 
"Okay, that's the Bourbon I know." 
"She's acting like she didn't just blow my
mind
lololol"

text_block_list.name: Viewer Comments
text_block_list.text:
"Bourbon's gonna Bourbon tho!"
"She's
perfect no matter what happens"
"I'm
gonna cheer for you foreveeeerrrr!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Update to operation "fan appreciation."
Mission
complete.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
There were no complications. Analyzing
fan
comments... Fans were "very happy."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Somewhere, a fan of mine will hold the
same
object and listen to the same music
as I do.
Change of status...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I am... um... Yes, "deeply moved."
